response.what_it_is: A black metal rolling stand and cage for a gas cylinder, featuring four caster wheels.
hidden_risks: Quality and strength of the welds under a heavy 60kg load
Durability and weight capacity of the caster wheels
Exact internal dimensions and stability when moving a full cylinder
seller_claims_unsupported: Capable of withholding over 60kg cylinder upright safely while moving
response.failure_mode: Confusing the gas cylinder stand for the gas cylinder itself, or overestimating load capacity from visual inspection alone.
